"""Response to bend-conditioned material modulus in the archived meridional pulse.

Inputs are the archived Q2 geometry and conversion state; use Euclidean P1
triangles in physical (r,w), not isoparametric Q1 quadrilaterals. The free
feed surfaces have zero stress impulse and remote ports use a passive local load.
"""
import argparse
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace

import numpy as np
from scipy.sparse import coo_matrix

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path('software/stage1_solver/tools').resolve()))
from mouth_shear_ringdown import prepared
from mouth_order_wave_pulse import mesh_geometry, quadratic
from mouth_flared_receiver import FlaredDomain
from mouth_curved_phase import RIM_SLOPE
from mouth_shear_cut import truncate

def emit(**fields):
    print(json.dumps(fields),flush=True)

def profile(w):
    neck=.5+.5*np.sin(np.arctan(RIM_SLOPE))
    return FlaredDomain.radius(SimpleNamespace(neck=neck,profile='cubic'),w)

def run(a):
    params=SimpleNamespace(mesh=34,radius=1.,state=None,outer=11.,feed_spacing=.12)
    dom,chi,_,_=prepared(params)
    dom,chi,cut=truncate(dom,chi,1.85)
    coords,blocks=mesh_geometry(dom,dom.grids,a.sub,False,feed_spacing=params.feed_spacing)
    plen=len(coords)
    moments=np.zeros(plen)
    weighted=np.zeros((2,plen))
    # Three-point symmetric triangle quadrature for mass and stiffness weights.
    Q=(np.eye(3)*.5+1/6)
    triangles=[]
    kval=[]
    for ib in (0,1,2,5):
        pg,vg,idx=blocks[ib]
        i,j=(x.ravel() for x in np.indices((len(pg)-1,len(vg)-1)))
        if ib==2:
            ok=pg[i+1]<=cut+1e-9
            i,j,idx=i[ok],j[ok],idx[ok]
        og,ov,old=dom.order_blocks[ib]
        for corner in ([0,2,3],[0,3,1]):
            tri=idx[:,corner]
            pcorner=np.column_stack((pg[i],pg[i],pg[i+1],pg[i+1]))[:,corner]
            vcorner=np.column_stack((vg[j],vg[j+1],vg[j],vg[j+1]))[:,corner]
            p=pcorner@Q.T
            v=vcorner@Q.T
            oi=np.searchsorted(og,p[:,0])-1
            oj=np.searchsorted(ov,v[:,0])-1
            sx=2*(p-og[oi,None])/np.diff(og)[oi,None]-1
            sy=2*(v-ov[oj,None])/np.diff(ov)[oj,None]-1
            shape=(quadratic(sx)[0][:,:,:,None]*quadratic(sy)[0][:,:,None,:]).reshape(-1,3,9)
            mu=np.einsum('eqa,ea->eq',shape,chi[old[oi*(len(ov)-1)+oj]])
            if mu.min()<=0: raise ArithmeticError(('nonpositive shear on live cells',ib,mu.min()))
            pos=coords[tri]
            r=pos[:,:,0]@Q.T
            v1=pos[:,1]-pos[:,0];v2=pos[:,2]-pos[:,0]
            det=v1[:,0]*v2[:,1]-v1[:,1]*v2[:,0]
            area=abs(det)*.5
            grad=np.zeros((len(tri),3,2))
            grad[:,1]=v2[:,[1,0]]*np.array([1,-1])/det[:,None]
            grad[:,2]=v1[:,[1,0]]*np.array([-1,1])/det[:,None]
            grad[:,0]=-grad[:,1]-grad[:,2]
            wt=(4*np.pi/3)*area[:,None]/mu
            local=(wt*r**4)@Q
            np.add.at(moments,tri.ravel(),local.ravel())
            depths=pos[:,:,1]@Q.T
            for wmass,(lo,hi) in zip(weighted,((.55,1.15),(1.2,2.0)),strict=True):
                z=np.clip((depths-lo)/(hi-lo),0.,1.)
                derivative=30*z*z*(1-z)**2/(hi-lo)
                np.add.at(wmass,tri.ravel(), ((wt*r**4*derivative**2)@Q).ravel())
            gr=3*r[:,:,None]*Q+r[:,:,None]**2*grad[:,None,:,0]
            gw=r[:,:,None]**2*grad[:,None,:,1]
            stiff=np.einsum('eq,eqa,eqb->eab',wt,gr,gr)+np.einsum('eq,eqa,eqb->eab',wt,gw,gw)
            triangles.append(tri)
            kval.append(stiff)
    tris=np.concatenate(triangles)
    k=coo_matrix((np.concatenate(kval).ravel(),(np.repeat(tris,3,axis=1).ravel(),np.tile(tris,(1,3)).ravel())),shape=(plen,plen)).tocsr()
    # Select all unique external edges topologically, including cut and extended feed.
    edge=np.vstack((tris[:,[0,1]],tris[:,[1,2]],tris[:,[2,0]]))
    ed,n=np.unique(np.sort(edge,axis=1),axis=0,return_counts=True)
    ed=ed[n==1]
    r=coords[ed,0]; w=coords[ed,1]
    mask_axis=np.max(abs(r),axis=1)<1e-9
    mask_feed=np.max(abs(r-params.outer),axis=1)<1e-9
    mask_cut=np.max(abs(w-cut),axis=1)<1e-9
    mask_wall=(w.mean(axis=1)>.5)&~(mask_axis|mask_cut)
    mask_free=~(mask_axis|mask_feed|mask_cut|mask_wall)
    live=moments>0
    live[ed[mask_free].ravel()]=False
    b=np.zeros((plen,2))
    dam=np.zeros(plen)
    source_points,weights=np.polynomial.legendre.leggauss(5)
    nlin=np.column_stack(((1-source_points)/2,(1+source_points)/2))
    for idx in ed[mask_wall]:
        wi=coords[idx,1]
        lo,hi=min(wi),max(wi)
        if hi<.66 or lo>1.10:
            continue
        wd=nlin@wi
        ra,slope=profile(wd)
        bump=np.maximum(0.,1-((wd-.88)/.22)**2)**3
        # T=(a' e_r+e_w)/sqrt(1+a'^2); line measure restores sqrt.
        f=4*np.pi*abs(wi[1]-wi[0])*.5*(weights*bump*ra**3)[:,None]*nlin
        b[idx,0]+=f.sum(axis=0)
        b[idx,1]-=(slope**2)@f
    for mask,ib in [(mask_feed,5),(mask_cut,2)]:
        edges=ed[mask]
        R=nlin@coords[edges,0].T
        length=np.linalg.norm(coords[edges[:,1]]-coords[edges[:,0]],axis=1)
        if ib==2:
            op,ov,old=dom.order_blocks[2]
            row=np.searchsorted(op,cut)-1
            size=profile(np.array([cut]))[0][0]
            vs=1-R/size
            j=np.broadcast_to(np.clip(np.searchsorted(ov,vs.mean(axis=0))-1,0,len(ov)-2),vs.shape)
            y=2*(vs-ov[j])/np.diff(ov)[j]-1
            endorder=chi[old.reshape(len(op)-1,len(ov)-1,3,3)[row,:,-1,:]]
            impedance=np.einsum('qei,qei->qe',quadratic(y)[0],endorder[j])
        else:
            impedance=np.ones_like(R)
        vals=(4*np.pi*weights[:,None]*R**4/impedance*(length/2)).T@nlin
        np.add.at(dam,edges.ravel(),vals.ravel())
    k=k[live][:,live]
    m=moments[live]
    b=b[live,0]
    dam=dam[live]
    weight=weighted[:,live]
    limit=np.max(np.asarray(abs(k).sum(axis=1)).ravel()/m)
    nstep=int(np.ceil(3*np.sqrt(limit)/1.48))
    dt=3/nstep
    u=np.zeros_like(b)
    vel=np.zeros_like(b)
    denom=m+dt*dam/2
    last=m-dt*dam/2
    work=0.;lost=0.
    avg=np.zeros((2,2));count=np.zeros(2)
    windows=[(20.,24.),(44.,48.)]
    for i in range(16*nstep):
        y=i/nstep
        drive=.01*10*y*y*(1-y)**2 if y<1 else 0.
        vnew=(last*vel+dt*(b*drive-k@u))/denom
        unew=u+dt*vnew
        vm=(vnew+vel)/2
        work+=dt*drive*(vm@b)
        lost+=dt*(dam@(vm*vm))
        for j,(lo,hi) in enumerate(windows):
            if lo<=(i+.5)*dt<hi:
                avg[j]+=weight@(vnew**2)
                count[j]+=1
        prev=u
        u=unew;vel=vnew
    energy=(m@vel**2+prev@(k@u))/2
    emit(mesh=a.sub, nodes=len(m), dt=dt, port=cut, work=work,energy=energy,
         windows=windows,tapers=[[.55,1.15],[1.2,2.0]],coefficient_per_lambda=(avg/count[:,None]).tolist(),
         norm_to_input_work=(avg/count[:,None]/work).tolist(),
         exported=lost,closure=(energy+lost-work)/work)
    assert np.all(count>0) and abs((energy+lost-work)/work)<5e-8

if __name__=='__main__':
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('--sub',type=int,required=True);run(p.parse_args())

"""Material correction on the native, unbent meridional edge-element wave.
Evaluate weighted curl strain at the same midpoint times as the bend reaction.
"""
from types import SimpleNamespace
from pathlib import Path
import sys

import numpy as np
from numpy.polynomial.legendre import leggauss
from scipy.sparse import coo_matrix
from scipy.sparse.linalg import splu

sys.path.insert(0,str(Path('software/stage1_solver/tools').resolve()))
from mouth_ringing_bend import setup, emit
from mouth_shear_ringdown import prepared
from mouth_order_wave_pulse import mesh_geometry,quadratic,tensor
from mouth_carrier_lateral_inertia import taper


def weighted(a):
    dom,chi,_,path=prepared(a)
    ids=(0,1,2,5)
    grids=[dom.grids[b] for b in ids]
    pg,vg=grids[2]
    grids[2]=(pg[pg<=pg[np.argmin(abs(pg-a.cut))]],vg)
    chart=SimpleNamespace(chart=lambda b,p,v:dom.chart(ids[b],p,v))
    points,blocks=mesh_geometry(chart,grids,a.sub,False)
    corners=np.array([[0,2],[1,3],[0,1],[2,3]])
    pairs=np.concatenate([x[2] for x in blocks])[:,corners]
    edges,index=np.unique(np.sort(pairs,axis=-1).reshape(-1,2),axis=0,return_inverse=True)
    sign=np.sign(pairs[:,:,1]-pairs[:,:,0])
    index=index.reshape(-1,4)
    x,gw=leggauss(4)
    gx,gy=(i.ravel() for i in np.meshgrid((1+x)/2,(1+x)/2,indexing='ij'))
    qw=(np.outer(gw,gw)/4).ravel()
    offset=0
    triplets=[]
    for b,(pg,vg,cells) in enumerate(blocks):
        which=ids[b]
        po,vo,old=dom.order_blocks[which]
        ii,jj=(k.ravel() for k in np.indices((len(pg)-1,len(vg)-1)))
        for first in range(0,len(cells),512):
            batch=slice(first,min(first+512,len(cells)))
            i,j=ii[batch],jj[batch]
            z0,z1=np.diff(pg)[i,None],np.diff(vg)[j,None]
            p,v=pg[i,None]+z0*gx,vg[j,None]+z1*gy
            r,w,rp,rv,wp,wv=dom.chart(which,p,v)
            jac=(rp*wv-rv*wp)*z0*z1
            oi,oj=i//a.sub,j//a.sub
            h=tensor(quadratic(2*(p-po[oi,None])/np.diff(po)[oi,None]-1)[0],
                     quadratic(2*(v-vo[oj,None])/np.diff(vo)[oj,None]-1)[0])
            xc=np.einsum('eqa,ea->eq',h,chi[old[oi*(len(vo)-1)+oj]])
            curl_sign=sign[offset+first:offset+batch.stop]*[1,-1,-1,1]
            hp=taper(w,.55,1.15)[1]
            integ=(4*np.pi*r*r*xc*hp**2/abs(jac))@qw
            mat=integ[:,None,None]*curl_sign[:,:,None]*curl_sign[:,None,:]
            ix=index[offset+first:offset+batch.stop]
            triplets.append((ix,mat))
        offset+=len(cells)
    ix=np.concatenate([s[0] for s in triplets]); values=np.concatenate([s[1] for s in triplets])
    n=len(edges)
    return n,coo_matrix((values.ravel(),(np.repeat(ix,4,axis=1).ravel(),np.tile(ix,(1,4)).ravel())),shape=(n,n)).tocsr()


def run():
    a=SimpleNamespace(mesh=34,sub=2,radius=1.,cut=1.85,outer=11.,dt=.025,feed_spacing=.1,state=None)
    (M,_,_,K,_,_,D),ell,free,_=setup(a)
    n,W=weighted(a)
    M,K,D=(p[:n,:n].tocsr() for p in (M,K,D))
    assert np.count_nonzero(ell[n:])==0
    ell=ell[:n]
    free=free[:n]
    dt=a.dt
    M0,K0,D0=(p[free][:,free].tocsr() for p in (M,K,D))
    solve=splu((M0+dt/2*D0+dt**2/4*K0).tocsc()).solve
    ml,kl,dl=[(p@ell)[free] for p in (M,K,D)]
    q,v=np.zeros(n),np.zeros(n)
    x,y=np.zeros(free.sum()),np.zeros(free.sum())
    I=Ivel=work=loss=0.
    windows=((24,48),(40,64))
    results=np.zeros((len(windows),3))
    for i in range(round(64/dt)):
        t=(i+1)*dt
        z=np.clip(t/3,0.,1.)
        next_v=.1*z*z*(1-z)**2
        vm=(Ivel+next_v)*.5
        next_I=I+dt*vm
        delta=next_v-Ivel
        midpoint=(next_I+I)*.5
        load= -ml*delta-dt*(dl*vm+kl*midpoint)
        current=solve(M0@y-dt/2*(K0@x)+load/2)
        next_x,next_y=x+dt*current,2*current-y
        qq=ell*next_I
        vv=ell*next_v
        qq[free]=next_x;vv[free]=next_y
        um=(q+qq)/2;uv=(v+vv)/2
        if vm:
            work+=vm*(ml@(next_y-y)+(ell@(M@ell))*delta+dt*(ell@(K@um+D@uv)))
        loss+=dt*uv@(D@uv)
        for j,(lo,hi) in enumerate(windows):
            z=(t-dt/2-lo)/(hi-lo)
            if 0<=z<=1:
                win=np.sin(np.pi*z)**2
                results[j]+=win*np.array((1.,um@(W@um),.5*(uv@(M@uv)+um@(K@um))))
        q,v,x,y=qq,vv,next_x,next_y
        I,Ivel=next_I,next_v
    E=.5*(v@(M@v)+q@(K@q))
    residue=E+loss-work
    emit(test='wave_strain_bend_material_native',sub=a.sub,dt=dt,outer=a.outer,windows=windows,work=work,
         final_energy=E,port_loss=loss,relative_closure=residue/work,results=[
        dict(stiffness_per_lambda=z[1]/z[0],instant_wave_energy_average=z[2]/z[0],
             extra_flare_force_for_lambda_one_and_offset_001= -.01*z[1]/z[0]) for z in results])
    assert abs(residue/work)<2e-6 and np.all(results>0)
run()
